thread:
maria.d: Customer acme-inc reported parse failures from /v1/generate with json_mode=true. ReqID req-98765. Model redwood-large-v1. Symptoms: response contains extra trailing text after the JSON, sometimes missing closing brace. Error string: Unexpected token in JSON at position 124. They saw 3 automatic retries and a billing spike.

aj: Can you paste the exact client request + response snippets and timestamp? Any reproducible prompt?

maria.d: Repro curl below (redacted token): 
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","json_mode":true,"prompt":"Extract items from the text in JSON array format."}'
```
Response we captured (truncated):
```json
{"items":[{"id":1,"name":"widget"}]}trailing garbage
```

lisa: Quick triage: looks like streaming truncation or concatenation on the client side. Two safe mitigations: (1) server-side sanitizer that strips non-json suffix before parse, (2) a re-ask/self-heal retry that asks the model to output strictly the JSON object again. Prefer (2) if we can avoid mutating user-visible output.

aj: If we do re-ask, limit retries to 2 and use exponential backoff with jitter. Example policy: initial 200ms, factor 2, jitter up to 100ms.

dave: Re-ask prompt example:
```text
System: You are a strict JSON generator. Only output the JSON object that matches the schema below. Do not include any commentary.
User: The previous response was cut off. Please output only the complete JSON object now.
```
Implement server-side check: try JSON.parse -> on failure, send re-ask with same context, then merge token usage into same request for billing.

sre-jen: Also checking logs, I see token-refresh errors around the same time causing duplicated requests. If clients retry on 401/5xx we can double-bill. Investigating auth refresh/failure windows; flagging infra.

support-bot: Assigned dave (eng) and lisa (support) to this thread.
dave: Acknowledged. I'll open ENG-4321 (runtime streaming reassembly) and include repro, raw bytes, and a mini harness to simulate chunk-boundary splits. Plan: add unit tests + canary. ETA EOD tomorrow.

aj: Quick regex sanitizer for support KB (client-side hotfix):
```js
// emergency heuristic: truncate after last JSON closing bracket/brace
const idx1 = resp.lastIndexOf('}');
const idx2 = resp.lastIndexOf(']');
const cut = Math.max(idx1, idx2);
if (cut !== -1) {
  const sanitized = resp.slice(0, cut + 1);
  JSON.parse(sanitized);
}
```
Note: heuristic and can break valid responses if used incorrectly. Document as emergency-only.

maria.d: Customer accepted temporary fallback to non-streaming mode and we've issued a provisional credit for the extra retries. They want a timeline for a permanent fix.

lisa: Also add metric & alert: json_parse_failures{customer="acme-inc"} > 5 in 10m -> page eng-oncall.

dave: We'll coordinate rollback plan if sanitizer causes regressions. Also considering disabling streaming by default for json_mode until runtime fix is validated.

maria.d: Thanks — please update this thread when ENG-4321 has status. I'll keep customer posted.
